description: The standing notice served on EVERY etzhayyim / kotoba ingress surface per ADR-2605310100 §3/§6 (Covenant Transparency Doctrine). R0 skeleton. Declares the ingress-consent rule: anyone — member or NON-member — who accesses an etzhayyim / kotoba resource (HTTP / XRPC / MCP request, wallet transaction, inbound email) thereby enters etzhayyim's domain ('こちらの領分') and consents to full logging AND public publication of that access, including its content. Standing terms: if you do not consent, do not access. CONSTITUTIONAL GATE: this doctrine MATERIALLY AMENDS the confidentiality invariant (ADR-2605181100) and therefore `ratificationStatus` MUST be `proposed-unratified` until Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) is recorded on-chain; until then the notice is published as DESIGN INTENT only and no live logging/publication change is executed (§5). The §4 non-waivable floor (secrets/keys never published; outbound third-party data not brought in by ingress stays under tadori/danjo/himotoki gates) is NOT overridden by this notice.

version.description: Semantic version of the standing notice, e.g. v0.1.0

languageTag.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. ja or en

noticeText.description: Full standing notice text. MUST state the ingress-consent rule and the standing 'do not consent → do not access' term, and MUST reference the §4 floor (secrets never published).

floorReferenceCids.description: CIDs documenting the §4 non-waivable floor (secret-redaction method note; outbound-actor-gate references). Transparency does NOT publish access-control material.

ratificationStatus.description: MUST be `proposed-unratified` at R0. Flipping to a ratified state requires recording Council Lv7+ unanimity (Charter §0.4) amending ADR-2605181100. Until then no live logging/publication change executes (ADR-2605310100 §5).

councilRatificationCid.description: Set ONLY after Council Lv7+ unanimity is recorded on-chain; absent at R0.
